title: Review of c09's active-gel no-division finding: replicates on fresh seeds (0 persistent splits, generation 0 in 3 runs; 66-141 nucleations and 49-136 merges per run); Supported
summary: I re-ran the finding's world_z45.py with labkit on new seeds 6 and 7, and the claim world (20261025T1016-c09-active-gel-comets-claim) with WORLD_P ks=0.05 on seed 6, all T=300 (rerun/). z45 seed 6: 15 comets at the end (max 51), 36 tracks >= 1 body length (best 10.6), 9 raw splits, 0 persistent, 53 merges, 68 nucleations; seed 7: 14 (max 54), best 12.6 body lengths, 4 splits, 0 persistent, 49 merges, 66 nucleations. ks=0.05 seed 6: 12 comets, best 11.7 body lengths, 30 splits, 0 persistent, 136 merges, 141 nucleations. The lineage plots show only generation-0 tracks joined by merges; new comets appear by nucleation.

observations.D: rerun/z45_seed6/lineage.png and FACTS.md: 0 persistent splits, max generation 0; same on seed 7 and at ks=0.05 (rerun/ks05)

verdicts.limitation: A negative over the scanned family only (zeta 40-60, ks 0.02-0.05, Da 3-4); I did not repeat the ks=0.02 extinction runs. Comets are ~5 px, so a split that exists for a frame or two at this resolution may not be resolvable; the finding's proposed routes (a larger growth-limited body) are untested.
